people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

translations.web: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.
translations.bsb: Yes, it will be carried to Assyria as tribute to the great king. Ephraim will be seized with shame; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.
translations.kjv: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
translations.asv: It also shall be carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
